# authwise_theme (Resource)

A tenant theme: the stylesheet and content the hosted login pages render with. Start from a layout's starter (`GET {issuer}/api/v1/ui/layouts`): its stylesheet template, `stylesheet_attributes` and `content`, and its two schemas. `layout` is fixed at creation; kit refuses a change, so another layout is another theme. Colours in `stylesheet_attributes` are six hex digits without `#`. An asset is named in `content` by its served URL, `/assets` plus the asset's `path`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A theme from the center layout's starter. center.json is the layout as
# the issuer lists it:
#
#   curl -s https://login.example.com/api/v1/ui/layouts \
#     | jq '.layouts[] | select(.key == "center")' > center.json
#
# examples/branding applies this with its logo and appearance profiles.
locals {
  center = jsondecode(file("${path.module}/center.json"))
}

resource "authwise_theme" "brand" {
  display_name = "Example brand"

  # Fixed at creation: kit refuses a change, so another layout is another
  # theme.
  layout     = "center"
  stylesheet = local.center.starter.stylesheet

  # The starter's values, with ours on top. Colours are six hex digits
  # without "#"; the stylesheet adds it.
  stylesheet_attributes = jsonencode(merge(local.center.starter.stylesheetAttributes, {
    primary_main   = "0B6E4F"
    link_color     = "0B6E4F"
    control_radius = "999px"
  }))

  # main_logo names an asset by its served URL: authwise_asset path
  # "/logo.svg" is served at "/assets/logo.svg".
  content = jsonencode(merge(local.center.starter.content, {
    heading   = "Welcome"
    main_logo = "/assets${authwise_asset.logo.path}"
  }))

  stylesheet_attributes_schema = jsonencode(local.center.stylesheetAttributesSchema)
  content_schema               = jsonencode(local.center.contentSchema)

  depends_on = [authwise_asset_content.logo]
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `content` (String) `content` as a JSON object.
- `content_schema` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `layout` (String)
- `placeholder_content` (String) `placeholder_content` as a JSON object.
- `placeholder_stylesheet_attributes` (String) `placeholder_stylesheet_attributes` as a JSON object.
- `stylesheet` (String)
- `stylesheet_attributes` (String) `stylesheet_attributes` as a JSON object.
- `stylesheet_attributes_schema` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default, and reads back from the name. Changing a configured one replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Full resource name; serves as the Terraform ID.
- `theme_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by full resource name.
terraform import authwise_theme.example tenants/t-01/themes/th-01
```
